title.zh-CN: 1.6.1 正式版 · 图片兼容性修复

summary.zh-CN: 识别图片真实格式与后缀不符的问题，备份后无损修复可处理的 PNG 素材，帮助恢复新版 lazer 中消失的长条主体等图像
summary.en-US: Detect mismatched image formats and extensions, then back up and losslessly repair supported PNG assets to restore hold bodies and other artwork missing in newer lazer

title.zh-CN: 图片兼容性检查与修复

zh-CN: 在素材工具中打开图片兼容性检查与修复，后台只读扫描真实格式，列出后缀不符、损坏、多帧及无法自动处理的图片
部分旧皮肤的 PNG 文件实际为 TIFF，新版 lazer 可能拒绝加载，使长条主体或其他素材消失，检查不局限于长条图片
勾选可修复的 PNG 目标后，将单帧、8 位图片无损转为真正 PNG，保持文件名、尺寸、透明度、RGBA 像素与配置引用
修复前将原文件备份到皮肤内的 __conflicts_backup 并保留相对路径，完成后刷新素材与预览，无法无损处理的图片不自动覆盖
en-US: Open Image compatibility check and repair under Asset tools to scan actual formats in the background without changing files, listing extension mismatches, damaged images, multiple frames and unsupported conversions
Some older skins name TIFF content as PNG, which newer lazer may reject, hiding hold bodies or other artwork; the scan is not limited to hold images
Select repairable PNG targets to losslessly convert single-frame, 8-bit images into real PNG while retaining filenames, dimensions, alpha, RGBA pixels and configuration references
Back up originals under the skin folder in __conflicts_backup with relative paths before replacement, refresh assets and previews afterward, and leave unsupported images untouched

zh-CN: 可修复 OSK 导入后的独立工作副本，再导出新 OSK 并重新导入 lazer，原始皮肤包保持不变
外部目录修复不会自动同步到 lazer 数据库中的皮肤，lazer 原生 JSON 控件布局仍保留在导出包中，预览范围不变
正式版构建号升为 11，高于 1.6.0 与 Beta r9，继续使用紧凑的双通道检查、一键更新、多线路和失败恢复，离线仅保留当前说明
en-US: Repair the independent working copy imported from an OSK, then export a new OSK and import it back into lazer while preserving the original package
Repairing an external folder does not update skins already stored in lazer databases; native JSON layouts remain preserved in exports without expanding preview support
Stable build number 11 is newer than 1.6.0 and Beta r9, retaining compact dual-channel checks, one-click updates, multiple routes and recovery while bundling only the current release note offline
